name: docpath
description: 文径 DocPath — 渐进式文档驱动工作流 (Document as Finite State Machine)

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/engine/breadcrumb.ts src/engine/transitions.ts src/engine/policy.ts src/governance/decisions.ts --format esm --clean --out-dir dist
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts src/engine/breadcrumb.ts src/engine/transitions.ts src/engine/policy.ts src/governance/decisions.ts --format esm --watch --out-dir dist
